notes: The source links this concentration to a Figure 1 size-distribution curve, not to the specific Figure 4 HREM particle.
The source gives a single 6–8 nm majority interval for the microemulsion series as a whole; it is not an independent size target for this AgNO3 concentration.

structure_assets.description: Author-used orthorhombic lattice dimensions a=0.433, b=0.706, c=0.776 nm (main p.3) represented as a geometric reference outline; no atomic positions, specimen refinement or measured structure file.

quality.review_scope: All four main-paper pages and Figures 1–4 independently quick- and deep-audited. SI and cited full texts not reviewed. The double-jet cohort and the Figure 2 representative particle remain distinct; microemulsion group-size context is not variant-specific.
missing_fields: AgNO3 stock volume, AOT mass/concentration, water-to-oil ratio, selenium stock amount/concentration and stirring duration are not reported.
The source's selenium-precursor name is retained as printed; its formula/structure is unresolved.
The 6–8 nm majority interval is group-level, not an individual mean for this concentration.
Figure 4 orthorhombic HREM particle is not linked to a stated AgNO3 concentration.
Orthorhombic lattice parameters are literature/simulation reference values, not a specimen refinement.
conflicts: Main p.3 repeats the heading 'Ag2Se Nanocrystals Made by Double Jet Precipitation' over a paragraph that compares AgNO3 concentration, cites Figure 1 microemulsion curves and then explicitly describes Figure 4 as microemulsion. Attribution to microemulsion follows paragraph body and Figure 4 caption; the heading conflict remains unresolved.
